key_features: High-Speed Performance: Sequential read speeds up to 7000 MB/s and write speeds up to 3800 MB/s.
Large Storage Capacity: 512GB provides ample space for your files, games, and applications.
PCI-Express 4.0 x4 Interface: Enhanced data transfer speed for faster performance.
Long-Lasting Durability: MTBF of over 1,000,000 hours ensures reliability over time.
High Endurance: 300 TBW (Total Bytes Written) rating ensures the drive can handle heavy usage.
Compact Design: M.2 2280 form factor for compatibility with most desktops and laptops.
Shock Resistance: Withstands 100 G/6 ms shock for added durability.
Vibration Resistance: 3.1 GRMS ensures stability in various environments.
Temperature Tolerance: Operating temperature from 0°C to 70°C and storage temperature from -40°C to 85°C.
